name: Mithril Bug Bounty VRF Ops (case-scoped)
description: One owning profile per Bug Bounty challenge (mithril-bb-<id>). Each tick runs the deterministic Mithril public review against every case the profile owns from data/canonical/challenges.json, writes receipts to R2 under bounty-vrf/<case>/ and Drive jklux, and writes the status row back into the shared Challenge Log via the Drive API (rclone public-client token refresh; no browser UI). Secondary in-scope repositories are separate canonical cases with a lowercase letter suffix (BB-0002b); they are reviewed and archived but do not carry a sheet row.
author: Mithril

configuration.case_binding: Profile name mithril-bb-<id> (or BBOPS_CASE, comma separated, matching canonical ids exactly) selects the primary case BB-<ID> and, if present in canonical, the secondary case BB-<ID>b from data/canonical/challenges.json.
configuration.google_access: rclone public Google OAuth client (202264815644.apps.googleusercontent.com); refresh token from the owning profile's data/rclone.conf; Sheets API is disabled for that project, so reads are Drive xlsx export and writes are multipart/related PATCH with read-back (google_sheets_sync.py).
configuration.r2: internal-security-nvd bucket (fund account 62e1fda53188460698f8c66d3aef59c6), prefix bounty-vrf/<case>/ (per-case ownership; no two profiles write the same key).
configuration.sheet: Only primary cases write the shared Challenge Log row of sheet 1gJ-CfDviZZltpc2qIlsW5hxs386E9fCWhkS0vR_50yo; sheet write-back is warn-and-continue.
configuration.cooldown: 12h per case after any recorded outcome (ok, refused, timeout, resolve_failed); a new tick then SKIPs the case.

retired.note: Legacy single profile; cron b9354d5b6999 paused 2026-10-10 in favour of the per-challenge profiles. Kept for state/history.
